model: Orbital Economy v7.7.7 Power Resource Capital candidate r1
note: Task 021 fragment. All numeric constants introduced by the Power Resource Mine simple_capital declaration are annotated, including the intentionally asymmetric A/B initial capacities 1750/650 and demand-signal initial values 1350/182.656. Reviewer merges accepted entries into the canonical registry.

Power Resource Capital Enabled.role: Power-resource-extraction simple-capital master switch, raw value 1.
Power Resource Capital Enabled.effect: 0 preserves accepted Modes 0-41 exactly; 1 applies the smooth mine-capacity cap and enables mine expansion, depreciation, retirement, and backing-resource sinks.

Power Resource Mine Capacity Reserve Fac.effect: Scales the smoothed Power Resource Demand Signal into desired mine capacity.

Power Resource Mine Construction Time.role: Power-resource-mine capacity construction time, value 90 days.
Power Resource Mine Construction Time.effect: Divides the positive capacity gap to set desired expansion speed before backing-resource coverage limits it.

Power Resource Mine Retirement Time.role: Power-resource-mine capacity surplus retirement time, value 360 days.
Power Resource Mine Retirement Time.effect: Controls removal rate of capacity above desired capacity.

Power Resource Mine Depreciation Rate.role: Power-resource-mine capacity depreciation rate, value 0.0001 per day.
Power Resource Mine Depreciation Rate.effect: Applies continuous physical attrition to Power Resource Mine Capacity while the mechanic is enabled.

Power Resource Mine Capital Goods per Ca.role: Capital Goods requirement per unit of new power-resource-mine capacity, value 0.02.
Power Resource Mine Capital Goods per Ca.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Capital Goods demand and actual expansion into Capital Goods consumption.

Power Resource Mine Construction Materia.role: Construction Materials requirement per unit of new power-resource-mine capacity, value 0.02.
Power Resource Mine Construction Materia.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Construction Materials demand and actual expansion into Construction Materials consumption.

A Power Resource Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital power-resource-mine capacity for colony A, value 1750.
A Power Resource Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds A mine capacity with intentional A/B asymmetry (1750 vs 650), chosen to start above current demand while leaving the smooth-cap mechanic observable.
A Power Resource Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_7_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2 explicitly require A=1750, B=650.

B Power Resource Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital power-resource-mine capacity for colony B, value 650.
B Power Resource Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds B mine capacity with intentional A/B asymmetry (650 vs 1750); B first adjusts to its rising startup demand and can rebuild under the Mode 43 surge.
B Power Resource Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_7_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2 explicitly require A=1750, B=650.

Power Resource Demand Signal Adjustment.role: Power-resource demand-signal adjustment time, value 3 days.
Power Resource Demand Signal Adjustment.effect: Controls lag from Power Resource Demand to the STOCK sizing signal and avoids same-step demand feedback.
Power Resource Demand Signal Adjustment.evidence: V7_7_7_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2; simple_capital STOCK sizing rule in lab/docs/NODES_RU.md.

A Power Resource Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed power-resource-demand signal for colony A, value 1350.
A Power Resource Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal at A's measured starting demand; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (1350 vs 182.656).

B Power Resource Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed power-resource-demand signal for colony B, value 182.656.
B Power Resource Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal at B's measured starting demand; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (182.656 vs 1350).
